Staff Pick ✔ Alex Feather-Light Active Ponyflo® Cap

Staff Pick ✔ Alex Feather-Light Active Ponyflo® Cap

Regular price $29.99
/
Shipping calculated at checkout.

So light-weight and breathable, you’ll forget you even have a hat on! The Alex Ponyflo® hat is a universal active hat that fits the needs of active women on all levels. Whether you’re going on a stroll in the park or running a marathon, this hat will keep your hair up and out of your way so your hair is the last thing you’ll need to worry about. Get this hat wet out in the ocean or keep it on all day during a heat wave- you’ll never have to worry about shrinkage or water damage. All Ponyflo® hats are specially designed for women with a unique back structure that supports high ponytails and buns.

  • Made with high-quality, lightweight fabric.
  • Provides ultimate UV protection.
  • Includes a built-in mesh fabric sweatband to wick moisture.
  • Designed with perforated side panels for maximum breathability.
  • Comfortable to wear during your workout and post-workout.
  • Made with unique “no-tangle” Velcro to adjust the tightness.
  • Designed with a low crown and a curved brim.
  • Hand wash cold

                  So light-weight and breathable, you’ll forget you even have a hat on! The Alex Ponyflo® hat is a universal active hat that fits the needs of active women on all levels. Get this hat wet out in the ocean or keep it on all day during a heat wave- you’ll never have to worry about shrinkage or water damage.                                                                                                         Stay On Strong

                                                                                                        We re-engineered the concept of a hat and created the Elastafit™ Secure design. Our hats are entirely open in the back to allow your hair to slide out comfortably! We designed a tangle-free closure that will never catch your hair.

                                                                                                        Elastafit™ Secure will wrap around your head and control your hair making sure your Ponyflo will always Stay On Strong.
